zh.title: 達美執行長反對希斯洛換航廈計畫　2028年將與維珍分開營運
zh.summary: 達美航空執行長批評希斯洛機場要求2028年遷往第四航廈的安排，認為不利旅客。
body: 據Simple Flying於11月14日發布的報導，達美航空執行長Ed Bastian公開反對倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）要求達美於2028年遷往第四航廈的決定。這項安排將使達美與維珍大西洋航空分開使用航廈。
Bastian批評該決定缺乏長遠考量，並認為會損害航空旅客權益。這是航空公司對未來航廈配置提出的異議，遷移時間為2028年。

en.title: Delta CEO objects to Heathrow Terminal 4 move planned for 2028
en.summary: Ed Bastian criticized a planned Heathrow terminal move that would separate Delta from Virgin Atlantic.
body: Simple Flying reported on November 14 that Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian had publicly opposed Heathrow Airport (LHR)’s decision to move Delta to Terminal 4 in 2028, separating it from Virgin Atlantic.
Bastian argued that the decision lacked long-term thinking and would harm passengers. His comments concern a future terminal arrangement scheduled for 2028.

facts.claim: Delta CEO Ed Bastian publicly criticized the decision to move Delta to Heathrow Terminal 4 in 2028.
The planned move would separate Delta from Virgin Atlantic.

zh.title: 西南航空洛杉磯飛奧蘭多航班　三組搖滾樂團輪番機上演出
zh.summary: Hoobastank、Simple Plan與The Used在西南航空航班演出，班機於全美暫停起飛前離地。
body: Simple Flying報導，Hoobastank、Simple Plan與The Used於11月13日在西南航空由洛杉磯飛往奧蘭多的航班上輪流演出，旅客拍攝的客艙影片隨後在社群平台流傳。三組樂團均預定參與奧蘭多的Vans Warped Tour活動。
報導指出，該航班在美國聯邦航空總署發布全美暫停起飛指令前離地。西南航空是活動合作夥伴，旗下Live at 35計畫安排機上音樂演出；Simple Flying表示，截稿前未取得航空公司針對這班飛機的回應。

en.title: Three rock bands perform aboard Southwest flight to Orlando
en.summary: Hoobastank, Simple Plan and The Used played aboard a Southwest flight that departed before the nationwide ground stop.
body: Hoobastank, Simple Plan and The Used performed aboard a Southwest Airlines flight from Los Angeles to Orlando on November 13, Simple Flying reported. Passenger videos of the cabin performances circulated on social media. All three bands were due to appear at Vans Warped Tour in Orlando.

The report says the aircraft departed before the FAA nationwide ground stop. Southwest is a festival partner and runs the Live at 35 inflight music program. Simple Flying said it had not received a Southwest response about this particular flight before publication.

facts.claim: Three bands performed aboard a Southwest flight from Los Angeles to Orlando.
The flight departed before the nationwide FAA ground stop, according to the report.

zh.title: 美航公告全美停飛後持續恢復營運　提醒旅客確認航班與改退票措施
zh.summary: 美國航空表示停飛造成的延誤與取消仍延續至11月14日，正調度機組與飛機恢復班表。
body: 美國航空於11月13日發布全美暫停起飛期間的營運公告，並在11月14日美中時間上午8時15分更新，表示前一天的停飛指令造成大量航班取消與延誤，團隊已徹夜調度飛機及機組，協助恢復班表。
美航表示，影響仍將延續至11月14日，包括進一步延誤與取消。旅客應於前往機場前，透過美航應用程式或官網確認航班；航空公司已發布旅遊警示，提供符合條件旅客變更訂位或退款的安排，適用條件以官方公告為準。

en.title: American continues recovery after nationwide ground stop
en.summary: American says residual cancellations and delays continue on November 14 as aircraft and crews are repositioned.
body: American Airlines first issued its nationwide ground-stop notice on November 13. In an update at 8:15 a.m. Central Time on November 14, it said the previous day’s disruption had caused significant cancellations and delays, with teams working overnight to restore schedules and reposition aircraft and crews.

American warned that further delays and cancellations would continue on November 14. It advised customers to check flight status before leaving for the airport and pointed to its travel alert for reservation changes or refunds, subject to the published conditions.

facts.claim: The original notice is dated November 13, 2026, 4:10 p.m. CT.
The November 14 update warns of residual cancellations and delays and directs customers to flight status and travel-alert options.

zh.title: 美國航空冬季七條國際航線陸續開航　涵蓋東京、阿姆斯特丹與波多
zh.summary: 美航2026／27冬季七條新增國際航線分階段開航，多數預定2027年初啟動。
body: 據Simple Flying整理的航班資料，美國航空在2026／27冬季新增七條國際航線。鳳凰城—墨西哥瓦哈卡航線已於10月29日至11月4日間執飛四班季節性航班；邁阿密—海地海地角航線則於11月1日開航，以波音737 MAX 8每日營運。
其餘航線預定於2027年啟動：邁阿密—委內瑞拉巴塞隆納為1月15日，芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）—東京成田為3月19日；紐約甘迺迪—阿姆斯特丹、紐約甘迺迪—特拉維夫，以及費城—葡萄牙波多，均預定3月27日開航。這些新增航線並非在同一天全部投入營運。
報導指出，東京成田線預定使用波音787-9；阿姆斯特丹及波多線使用空中巴士A321XLR，特拉維夫線使用波音777-200ER。旅客訂位前仍應以航空公司當時班表為準。

en.title: American Airlines adds seven international routes across winter season
en.summary: American’s seven winter additions open in stages, with most scheduled to start in early 2027.
body: American Airlines has added or plans seven international routes for winter 2026–27, according to schedule data summarized by Simple Flying. Phoenix–Oaxaca operated four seasonal flights between October 29 and November 4. Miami–Cap-Haïtien began daily Boeing 737 MAX 8 service on November 1.

Miami–Barcelona in Venezuela is scheduled for January 15, 2027, followed by Chicago O’Hare–Tokyo Narita on March 19. New York JFK (JFK)–Amsterdam, New York JFK–Tel Aviv and Philadelphia–Porto are scheduled for March 27. The seven routes therefore do not all begin together.
The report lists the Boeing 787-9 for Narita, Airbus A321XLR for Amsterdam and Porto, and Boeing 777-200ER for Tel Aviv. Travelers should confirm the current airline timetable before booking.

facts.claim: Seven winter routes include Phoenix–Oaxaca, Miami–Cap-Haïtien, Miami–Barcelona, Chicago–Narita, JFK–Amsterdam, JFK–Tel Aviv and Philadelphia–Porto.
Most remaining starts are scheduled for January or March 2027.

zh.title: 聯航申請限制飛往芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）航班　疏導壅塞後措施已解除
zh.summary: 聯合航空因登機門壅塞申請暫緩部分飛往歐海爾航班起飛，並表示限制已結束。
body: 在美國全國性暫停起飛指令解除後，聯合航空於11月14日另申請針對部分飛往芝加哥歐海爾國際機場（ORD）的航班實施暫停起飛措施，以減輕登機門壅塞，優先處理積壓的離場航班。
聯航向Simple Flying確認，這項局部限制已經結束。措施針對準備飛往歐海爾的部分航班，與前一天的全美暫停起飛指令屬不同階段；航空公司正持續調度飛機與機組，以恢復正常營運。

en.title: United’s targeted O’Hare ground stop expires after congestion relief
en.summary: United says a temporary restriction on some inbound O’Hare flights has ended.
body: United Airlines requested a targeted ground stop on some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare on November 14 to relieve gate congestion and prioritize departures after the previous day’s nationwide disruption, Simple Flying reported.

United confirmed to the outlet that the targeted restriction had expired. It was intended to manage arrivals into O’Hare while the airline cleared departing aircraft and worked to restore normal operations.

facts.claim: United requested a targeted FAA action limiting some inbound O’Hare flights to prioritize departures.
United confirmed that the targeted ground stop had expired.
